body.name: App Store
body.description: The one place to install, upgrade and remove applications in this organisation.

permissions.label: Manage App Store
permissions.description: Allows managing App Store definition-level administration.

props.text: Every application this organisation has published. Install an application to make it available here, or upgrade one to its latest version. Select an application to see what its latest version changes.

flows.description: Reviews the latest published version of the selected application, then installs it for the first time or upgrades to it after the person confirms.

parts.value: Installing adds these roles to this organisation, each with what it lets people do. Nobody has a role until it is given to them in IAM.

else.value: is installed with its roles. Give people their roles in IAM; people with a role find the application in the launcher.

flows.description: Removes an installed ordinary application after confirming the retained records and withdrawn access.

literal.value: Its pages and launcher entry will be removed from this organisation. Its application roles and existing assignments will stop granting access. Records and storage are kept, along with published definitions, so the app can be reinstalled from the App Store. Reinstalling requires accepting roles and assigning access again.
